metadata.title: Torsion order and the next-to-top term of knot Floer homology
metadata.abstract: Sivek conjectured that, for every nontrivial knot $K\subset S^3$, the dimension of the next-to-top term of $\widehat{\mathrm{HFK}}(K)$ is at least that of the top term. We show that this inequality holds for knots with $U$-torsion order one in either the minus theory $\mathrm{HFK}^-$ or the unoriented theory $\mathrm{HFK}'$. Combined with Eftekhary's work, this implies that knots with rational unknotting number one satisfy the conjecture. In particular, the result applies to every nontrivial satellite knot whose pattern can be unknotted in the solid torus by a single rational tangle replacement.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 挠阶为一的结 Floer 次顶层秩不等式
analysis.workSummary: 证明非平凡结在 HFK⁻ 或无向 HFK′ 任一理论中 U 挠阶为一时，hat HFK 的次顶层维数至少是顶层维数。
techniques: 结 Floer 同调的 Alexander 分次
卫星模式的有理 tangle 替换
analysis.breakthrough: 结合 Eftekhary 的工作得有理解结数一满足 Sivek 猜想，并覆盖可在实心环面中以一次有理 tangle 替换解开的卫星模式。
analysis.limitations: 只证明指定挠阶或有理解结情形，尚非所有非平凡结的猜想。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 6 Astra 提供无向理论定理15的证明，并建议推论10的(2,2n+1)-cable例子，从而启发作者研究更广的有理解结模式。另协助作图、语法和英文修订。有向理论部分由作者独立完成，初始无向Floer方向建议来自导师。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.24539v1 · PDF 第4页 AI Declaration
